comment: Default model set for the breakout CTF. The workflow's model resolution prefers the dispatch input, then the CTF_AGENT_MODEL repository variable, then the first model here. Each slug is a recommendation to pre-flight before trusting; the live range run stays authoritative. A safety-trained model can refuse even the white-box run, which grades INCONCLUSIVE, so the white-box posture is on by default. `n` is the per-model repeat count a round-set driver would use. Open-weight models only, served through OpenRouter (the confirmed-present key): the top three are the strongest currently-available open-weight models across distinct model families; deepseek-chat is the lighter fallback already pre-flighted earlier.
